title: The issue list of one claude-seo full audit (docs/research/seo-audit-N/findings.json, and findings_sf.json: the same list, Site Factory's items only)
description: Owner 2026-11-17: after the site is done, one claude-seo full audit by default, then fixes by hand and in the pipeline. scripts/lib/claude-seo-audit.mjs validateFindings checks a file against this schema and adds what a schema cannot say: ids unique, a google-rules quote at most SEO_AUDIT_QUOTE_WORDS words, findings_sf.json only owner sf. Each auditor's reply is checked against it too, before the replies are merged (reported_by is the merge's).

audit.description: The audit folder, relative to the site (docs/research/seo-audit-N).

only.description: Set on a list of one owner's findings (findings_sf.json: sf).

id.description: The report's own id (H-1, C-M2, T-L4).

section.description: The report section it is listed in.

url.description: The page (a route such as /about-us/, or /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml), or server/<file> for the server config.

location.description: Text or markup copied exactly from the file at url (... or the ellipsis character between fragments). For an absence, what stands where the missing thing should be.

doc.description: The document's title in the Google rules library.

quote.description: One sentence of the document, verbatim.

ref.description: Where the audit shows it: a section of FULL-AUDIT-REPORT.md, a measurement file, a screenshot.

owner.description: sf: Site Factory (the copy, the page plan); 08: this template (markup, structured data, build, server, photos); owner: the site's owner (facts, documents, accounts, decisions).

check.description: How to see that it is fixed.

reported_by.description: The auditors who reported it (config/claude-seo-auditors.json ids, as ["a1", "a3"]); its length is how many of them did. Owner 2026-11-17: three auditors at once, their findings merged. Absent on an audit of one auditor (files before 2026-11-17).
